Terastal Debut |plain_title=Pocket Monsters: Terastal Debut |image=Pocket Monsters Terastal Debut logo.png |size=240px |arc=Arc |number=3 |opening=Will (song){{!}}Will |ending=Let me battle |numeps=22 ([[HZ046]]-[[HZ067]]) |region=[[Paldea]] |series=''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |prevlink=The Sparkling of Terapagos |prev=Pocket Monsters: The Sparkling of Terapagos |nextlink=Rayquaza Rising |next=Pocket Monsters: Rayquaza Rising |seo= }} (Japanese: '''テラスタルデビュー''' ''Terastal Debut'') is the third arc of {{aniseries|HZ}} that aired on [[TV Tokyo]] from April 12, 2024 to September 27, 2024. It is preceded by ''[[The Sparkling of Terapagos]]'' and followed by the ''[[Rayquaza Rising]]'' arc. This chapter focuses on [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]] as they enroll at [[Naranja Academy]] in [[Paldea]] to undergo [[Tera Training]]. Their {{pkmn|journey}} involves battling [[Paldea]]'s [[Gym Leader]]s, encountering the [[Paldea Elite Four]], and facing infiltration attempts by the [[Explorers]]. The arc serves as the characters' formal introduction to {{Tera}}stallization and culminates in a [[Tera Training Student Battle Tournament|student tournament]] before their departure from the academy. The arc's opening theme is {{so|Will}} performed by {{wp|IVE (group)|IVE}}, and the ending theme is [[Let me battle]] by 9Lana. {{spoilers}} ==Plot== [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]] enroll at [[Naranja Academy]] alongside [[Explorers]] members [[Coral]] and [[Sidian]], who are undercover. The trio receives [[Tera Orb]]s from [[Geeta]] and are assigned to battle specific [[Gym Leader]]s to complete their Terastal training: Liko faces [[Katy]] in [[Cortondo]], Roy battles [[Brassius]] in [[Artazon]], and Dot challenges [[Iono]] in [[Levincia]]. During their training, they reunite with [[Ann]], whose {{p|Oshawott}} has evolved into {{p|Dewott}}, and discover that [[Chalce]] has become a teacher at the academy, who is working undercover. After completing their first tests, the group faces second-round challenges against [[Larry]], [[Ryme]], and [[Grusha]]. During this period, Roy's {{p|Wattrel}} evolves into {{TP|Roy|Kilowattrel}} and Liko's {{p|Hatenna}} evolves into {{TP|Liko|Hattrem}}. The training takes a dangerous turn when [[Spinel]] traps Liko and [[Amethio]] in a cave beneath [[Glaseado Mountain]], leading to revelations about [[Gibeon]] and the Explorers' goals. Amethio is subsequently placed on probation for helping Liko escape. The arc climaxes when the Explorers attack Naranja Academy to steal data about {{an|Terapagos}}. During this crisis, the students participate in a tournament where Roy's {{p|Fuecoco}} evolves into {{TP|Roy|Crocalor}}, and Roy defeats Liko in their battle. The arc concludes with the trio completing their Terastal training and departing the academy, while Spinel begins analyzing the stolen Terapagos data. ==Gallery== ===Promotional material=== Pokémon
